title: Pain feeling extra loud today?
caption: Pain feeling extra loud today? The day has a wobbly, up-and-down feel, and waves may pop when lights are bright or sounds get loud. Keep tasks small with tiny pauses, and dim screens or soften light to take the edge off.
snapshot: Magnetic conditions reached an active band with a southward lean at times. Solar wind is typical, and no flares were logged. A recent coronal ejection was seen with no sign of Earth arrival.
affects: Flare‑prone folks may notice pain or fatigue step up in waves, with concentration dipping when things get bright or loud. These waves can be brief and tied to stimulation. If your system is already stirred up, the day may feel a bit louder than usual.
playbook:
- Keep tasks bite‑sized with tiny pauses
- Dim screens and soften lighting
- Hydrate and add a small salty snack if helpful
- Step outside for a minute of steady daylight
- Check local allergens, smoke, or humidity if relevant
